scripts.build: npm run build -w @agendaflow/shared && npm run build -w @agendaflow/api && npm run build -w @agendaflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agendaflow/shared && npm run test -w @agendaflow/api
scripts.check: npm run spec:check && npm run arch:check && npm run build && npm test
